title: Chief Tech alignment + proposed deep-dive/demo time slots
text:
Chief Tech alignment + proposed deep-dive/demo time slots

["From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Ng <alyssa.ng@fathomtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Chief Tech alignment + proposed deep-dive/demo time slots

Hi Alyssa —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

What we heard (summary)
- Primary goal: move from POC to a pilot focused on inference cost reduction and 99th %-tile latency under production load.
- Key constraint: secure VPC networking + SOC2 evidence required for procurement.
- Success metric: <60ms median for small LLM queries, and predictable throughput for burst windows.

Open qualification items
- Estimated daily QPS and percent of long-context requests (>2k tokens)?
- Any hard isolation requirements for multi-tenant workloads?

Suggested next steps
1) Executive introduction (VP / CTO handshake) — 30 minutes to align stakeholders and gating items.
2) Technical deep-dive + demo — 60 minutes with Markus to walk infra, benchmarks, and pilot scope.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Exec intro: Tue Aug 3, 2027 — 10:30-11:00 or 16:00-16:30
- Deep-dive + demo: Wed Aug 4, 2027 — 14:00-15:00 OR Thu Aug 5, 2027 — 09:00-10:00

If those don't fit, tell me two times that work for Michael/your team and we'll adapt.

Attached: discovery-recap.pdf (1 page), redwood-product-sheet.pdf.

For the deep-dive, Markus will prepare: short latency/cost benchmark slides, recommended quantization/instance profiles, and a proposed pilot timeline. If you can share a short sample of your query shape or a simple QPS estimate ahead of time, Markus can tailor the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
[Attachment: discovery-recap.pdf]
[Attachment: redwood-product-sheet.pdf]", "From: Alyssa Ng <alyssa.ng@fathomtech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fathomtech.com
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Chief Tech alignment + proposed deep-dive/demo time slots

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our notes. We're interested in moving to a pilot as discussed. A couple quick answers:
- Typical QPS for the service we'd onboard is ~120 req/minute with spikes up to ~900/minute for 10-15 minute windows.
- ~8% of requests use longer contexts (2k+ tokens).
- We need VPC+KMS for key material; SOC2 is required by our procurement process.

Michael Li (CTO) can join the exec intro. He is available:
- Tue Aug 3 — not available in the morning, can do 16:00-16:30 PDT
- Wed Aug 4 — 11:00-11:30 PDT would work for a brief handshake

For the deep-dive/demo, Michael and our infra lead prefer Wed Aug 4, 2027 14:00-15:00 PDT — that slot works for us (Markus' materials will be useful).

I'll loop procurement on the SOC2 checklist — procurement@fathomtech.com.

Thanks — I'll hold the Wed 14:00 slot tentatively until you confirm.

Best,
Alyssa Ng
Director, Platform Engineering | FathomTech
alyssa.ng@fathomtech.com | +1 206-555-0822

On Sun, Aug 1, 2027 at 16:12 Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: ...
", "From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Chief Tech alignment + proposed deep-dive/demo time slots

Markus / Marissa —

Forwarding Alyssa's reply: they're tentatively holding Wed Aug 4, 14:00-15:00 PDT for the technical deep-dive + demo and would like a short exec intro as well (Michael Li available Tue 16:00-16:30 PDT or Wed 11:00-11:30 PDT).

Actions:
- Markus: can you lead the deep-dive on Wed 8/4 14:00? Please prepare:
  - 10-min infra + architecture walkthrough tailored to VPC/KMS constraints
  - 10-min benchmark slides focused on 99th-% latency and cost per 1k tokens
  - Pilot scope and timeline (draft one-pager attached)
- Marissa: please create calendar invites for both slots (exec handshake + deep-dive) and include the HubSpot deal. Add procurement@fathomtech.com on the invite.

Attachments: pilot-scope.docx (very rough, please iterate).

If Markus needs Alyssa's query profile or a sample payload, ping Alyssa directly and I'll CC.

Thanks — want to get these on both calendars today to unblock procurement.

Best,
Grace

> [Quoted message from Alyssa Ng <alyssa.ng@fathomtech.com> Sun, 1 Aug 2027 17:05:00 -0700]
> Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our notes. We're interested in moving to a pilot as discussed...
", "From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Chief Tech alignment + proposed deep-dive/demo time slots

Grace / Marissa —

I can take the deep-dive on Wed 8/4 at 14:00 PDT. I'll prepare the following deliverables:
- Short slide deck (10 slides) showing latency distributions, 99th-% analysis, and recommended quantization/instance profiles for the mix you shared (~8% long-context).
- Two benchmark scenarios: baseline (current infra) vs Redwood-configured pilot with continuous batching + KV cache.
- Pilot runbook + minimal infra checklist for VPC/KMS (will highlight SOC2 evidence we can provide).

A couple asks:
1) Could Alyssa share a sample request histogram or small anonymized payloads (no PII) — even a simple CSV with tokens-per-request distribution helps tune quantization and batch sizes.
2) Any specific compliance artifacts procurement needs ahead of the exec intro? If so, Marissa, please compile and I'll help prioritize.

Marissa — once you send invites, please include this agenda and attach the pilot-scope.docx + discovery-recap.pdf. I'll review the pilot-scope and send comments tonight.

I'll be on the invite and will block prep time Tue afternoon.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Inference Engineering | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
